newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan Congress ends ordinary sessions.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan Congress ends ordinary sessions.

text.p: Venezuela's Congress ended its first period of ordinary sessions for 1997 Sunday, but legislators said extraordinary sessions would likely be convened shortly to deal with pending legislation.

Sessions are not due to recommence until October 1, but Congressmen said they expected to start extraordinary sessions before the end of July to study bills including the 1998 budget, privatization of state steel and aluminum companies and social security reform, local papers reported Monday.
